name: Compare two design systems
summary: Puts two design systems side by side and shows where they differ — colour roles, type scale, corners, spacing, depth, components.
description: A comparison tool on DesignMD: two design systems are measured from the live sites and shown side by side — colour roles, type scale, corners, spacing, depth and components. Two public Discover sites make a public comparison page; signing in is needed to compare your own generations.
